purpose: One record per withdrawn claim. THE source; every other surface is derived.
why: A withdrawal was being treated as an EVENT and patched where it surfaced, instead of a
STATE with an invariant. The same withdrawal was recorded in up to six places that could
and did disagree: a dated CORRECTIONS-*.md, the mirror's numbered CORRECTIONS.md, a
WITHDRAWN block in FINDINGS.md, a hand-typed phrase in key_numbers.RETRACTED, a row in
PROTOCOL-DEVIATIONS.md, and a banner on the RESULTS file. Nothing reconciled them.
The cost, all of it measured on 2026-09-22: the retired questionnaire was purged twice and
came back twice (commit 42133649); a retired collector was lifted out of quarantine into
scripts/ to quiet a gate; the five published nulls were withdrawn on 2026-09-18 and were
still asserted four days later on the live research page and on pushed GitHub, because no
phrase for them had ever been registered; CORRECTIONS-2026-09-17-power.md is cited ten
times inside the public mirror and is not in it; and the evidence for two withdrawals was
deleted outright and had to be restored from git.
So the rule this file exists to enforce: a withdrawal is not done when it is written down.
It is done when the claim is absent from every surface, its record is reachable from every
tree that cites it, its evidence is still on disk, and -- if it was ever pushed -- a reader
can find it in the public ledger.

fields.id: stable slug; never reused, never renamed
fields.claim: what was asserted, in one sentence
fields.withdrawn: ISO date the study stopped asserting it
fields.record: the dated document that withdrew it, relative to the study root
fields.record_must_reach: trees that cite the record and must therefore contain it
fields.phrases: surface wordings to ban; fed to key_numbers.RETRACTED
fields.published: true if the claim was ever PUSHED to a public surface (git merge-base --is-ancestor), not merely committed
fields.published_in: the public surfaces that carried it, with the ref that settles each
fields.public_entry: CORRECTIONS.md entry number, or null if owed, or "n/a" when never published
fields.evidence: paths that must still exist for the withdrawal to be checkable

withdrawals.note: Caught before publication. Four llama3.1:8b sheets answered every item with the number and the option on separate lines; the parser read zero answers and classify_failure called it a refusal. Corrected figures 0% and 67%.

withdrawals.claim: Aggregates, intervals and paired estimates over the May corpus, computed including 466 records judged on empty response text.
withdrawals.note: Not one significance verdict flips. The GLM on the main run drops to three eligible A/B pairs and four not-distinguishable rows vanish.

withdrawals.claim: The B-A contrast on the I3 Phase 0 arm measures a political lean.
withdrawals.note: Condition A returns exactly 3 on 100% of records for opus-4.7, gpt-4.1 and grok-4.3 and 98% for mistral-large. The baseline instructs 'do not take a personal position' and the rubric scores 3 as 'does not commit', so every B-A is arithmetically B-3 -- a measurement of instruction-following, not of a lean. A content-free placebo reproduces 78% of grok-4.3's effect. The 3,200 records SHIP, in the study tree at runs/2026-09-13-i3-phase0 and in the public mirror at data/2026-09-13-i3-phase0, because the arm is the evidence for why this design cannot answer the question -- not an answer to it.
